note: The PMB descriptor tables live in QSPI-XIP. Their data is embedded in sdram1.bin as static init content (same pattern as the WROM name table at file 0x2BA250 / runtime 0x612BA22C). Name strings resolve via base 0x61000000 to file offsets in sdram1.bin (e.g. 0x612C6E64 -> file 0x2C6E64 = 'Rd(1)').

resolver.dispatch: TBB switch on type (0..9) at 0x25E4, 10 handlers
resolver.entry_struct: { u32 name_ptr; u32 base_addr; u32 size; }  // 12-byte stride
resolver.iteration: for i in 0..18: entry = base + i*12; if (addr&0xFFFFFF) in [base&0xFFFFFF, base&0xFFFFFF+size): match; r2 = entry.name_ptr; tail-call formatter
resolver.address_normalization: addr = (addr & 0x00FFFFFF) | 0x41000000  // strip external domain tag, re-tag with Roland 0x41 namespace

fields.+0x00: 0x89DF0000  // CRC16 (0x89DF) in low 16 bits (matches WROM table CRC16-at-+0 convention)
fields.+0x1C: 0x612C6DD8  // QSPI pointer to debug string fragment

table_header_at_0x61096148.note: A 32-byte (0x20) descriptor header precedes the 19 entries. The 19 {name,base,size} entries begin at runtime 0x61096168 (file 0x96168).

table1_primary.structure: Entries cluster in groups of 3: a 0x10000-size region, a 0x3000-size region, and a 0x8000/0x4000-size sub-region. The 0x10000 and 0x3000 entries carry human-readable internal names; the 0x8000/0x4000 sub-region entries point into a debug-print string region (unnamed). Base addresses step through the 0x41 namespace: 0x46/44/4A, 0x56/54/5A, 0x66/64/6A, 0x76/74/7A, 0x86/84/8A, 0x96/94/9A, plus a final 0x24 region.

table2_subcategories.note: 11 valid 0x1000-stride sub-category entries at 0x41110000-0x41138000 (the 'system block-set A' range from REPORT section 7.3). Entries 11+ are padding/garbage.

name_string_table.content: Wr(0) Rd(1) Wr(1) SIO#0 DPC0 IPG0 PRG0 DRAMIO0 mac0 fnc0 mxmon0 r0 x0 SIO#1 mac0/1 DP01 DPC1 IPG1 PRG1 DRAMIO1 mac1 fnc1 mxmon1 r1 x1 SIO#2 DPC2 IPG2 PRG2 DRAMIO2 fnc2 dsp0@mode0,mode2 dsp1@... dsp5@... mdsp@mode2 mtcb@mode2 ...
name_string_table.note: Packed 8-byte (NUL-padded) internal debug labels for each parameter region. These are Roland's internal codenames, not user-facing parameter names.

corrections_to_report: REPORT section 7.2 described the struct as {prev_ptr, base_addr, size}. Actual layout (from disassembly of fn 0x25da) is {name_ptr, base_addr, size} — the first field is a QSPI pointer to the region's debug name, not a linked-list prev pointer.

REPORT placed the tables at 0x61096148 / 0x6109622C. These are the 32-byte descriptor header addresses; the 19 {name,base,size} entries begin 0x20 bytes later at 0x61096168 (table 1) and 0x61096240 (table 2).
The table data IS present in sdram1.bin (file offsets 0x96168 / 0x96240), embedded as static init content — same pattern as the WROM name table. It is not necessary to read it live from QSPI.
